name: ui-tick
prompt: A short soft UI tick, like a small plastic button click in a quiet room.

name: menu-select
prompt: A gentle two-tone wooden marimba tap confirming a menu selection.

name: dig-soft
prompt: A single scoop of a small shovel into loose dry soil, soft earthy scrape.

name: dig-hard
prompt: A heavy shovel strike into compacted banded clay with a dull gritty crunch.

name: deny-buzz
prompt: A short dull error buzz, like a low electric doorbell denying entry.

name: water-release
prompt: A sluice gate opening with a sustained gush of water pouring into an earthen channel.

name: water-splash
prompt: A small water splash, droplets landing in a shallow pool.

name: well-fill
prompt: A bright droplet plink echoing inside a stone well as water arrives.

name: water-fouled
prompt: A sour gurgling sizzle of clean water turning murky in a drain.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: A quick tape-rewind whoosh sliding downward in pitch.

name: round-win
prompt: A cheerful rising bell arpeggio celebrating a well filled with clean water.

name: round-lose
prompt: A soft descending mallet phrase, disappointed but gentle.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: A bright three-note wind chime sparkle announcing an unlocked achievement.

name: hint-glimmer
prompt: A soft glassy two-note glimmer, like a small bell tapped twice rising in pitch, gentle and quick.

name: spring-dry
prompt: The last trickle of water from an old iron pipe sputtering and stopping, a final drip echoing in a cave.

name: pause-hush
prompt: A soft muffled cloth thump with a short low hum fading, like a lid closing gently on a wooden box.

name: resume-swell
prompt: A gentle short upward swell, like a wooden lid lifting with a small breath of air and a light tap.
